diagnostics.help: Initialize the ref lazily so expensive values are not rebuilt and discarded on every render.

diagnostics.title: JS-thread animation instead of Reanimated
diagnostics.message: Your users see stutter when Animated from react-native runs on the JS thread.
diagnostics.help: Use `import Animated from 'react-native-reanimated'` so animations run on the UI thread instead of the JS thread, which keeps them smooth.

diagnostics.title: Legacy platform-specific shadow styles
diagnostics.message: Shadow style "elevation" only work on one platform, so your users on the other see no shadow.
diagnostics.help: Use `boxShadow` for shadows that work on both platforms on the new architecture, instead of platform-specific shadow properties.

diagnostics.title: Platform-specific shadow keys over boxShadow
diagnostics.message: Your users on the other platform see no shadow when you use elevation.
diagnostics.help: These shadow keys only work on one platform. On RN v7+, use the CSS `boxShadow` string instead, like `boxShadow: "0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)"`, which works on both.
